_nota: Prompts de video (Kling 3.0, 1080p, 16:9, cuadro inicial = placa graduada subida) usados el 27 oct para V2 MOVIMIENTO y V3 DETALLE de las situaciones. Sufijo comun de los detalles: 'The camera does not move at all and the framing does not change. Only the movement described happens; nothing else in the frame moves. No new hand, face or figure enters the frame. Hands keep their natural arrangement: the fingers never splay and never change in number. Skin stays a flat desaturated warm grey, never pink. The flat graphic illustration style, the light and the near-monochrome palette stay exactly unchanged.'
